description.value: Misty Mountain Pizza has been feeding mountain bikers and skiers since 1991 across two BC locations: Rossland and Whistler. The pizzeria offers whole pies, pasta, and in-store slices, with gluten-free crusts and dairy-free cheese available. The Rossland location sits in the heart of Kootenay mountain bike and ski country, making it a natural stop for touring cyclists passing through the region.

The website does confirm a Rossland location exists ('2 great locations, Rossland and Whistler'), but no Rossland address or phone number appears in the fetched content. Amenity evidence is drawn from the Whistler subpage, which may not fully reflect the Rossland location. The website explicitly confirms gluten-free and dairy-free options, delivery, and in-store by-the-slice sales.
